description: This file defines the DispatchKeySet class and related utilities for managing sets of dispatch keys used in PyTorch's dispatch mechanism, including functionality for handling backend and functionality bits, set operations, and iteration over dispatch keys.

classes.name: DispatchKeySet
classes.description: A class representing a set of dispatch keys, supporting set operations, iteration, and querying for highest priority keys, used internally in PyTorch for dispatching tensor operations.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a specific DispatchKey is in the set.

methods.name: has_backend
methods.description: Checks if a specific BackendComponent is in the set.

methods.name: has_all
methods.description: Checks if all keys in another DispatchKeySet are contained in this set.

methods.name: has_any
methods.description: Checks if any keys in another DispatchKeySet are contained in this set.

methods.name: isSupersetOf
methods.description: Checks if this set is a superset of another DispatchKeySet.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Returns the union of this set with another DispatchKeySet.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Returns the intersection of this set with another DispatchKeySet.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Returns the set difference, only affecting functionality keys.

methods.name: operator^
methods.description: Returns the symmetric difference of this set with another DispatchKeySet.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new DispatchKeySet with a DispatchKey or another DispatchKeySet added.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Returns a new DispatchKeySet with a DispatchKey removed (only functionality keys).

methods.name: remove_backend
methods.description: Returns a new DispatchKeySet with a backend bit removed.

methods.name: highestFunctionalityKey
methods.description: Returns the highest priority functionality DispatchKey in the set.

methods.name: highestBackendKey
methods.description: Returns the highest priority backend component in the set.

methods.name: highestPriorityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the DispatchKey of highest priority in the set.

methods.name: indexOfHighestBit
methods.description: Returns the index of the most significant bit in the set.

methods.name: getDispatchTableIndexForDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Returns the index in the operator dispatch table for the highest priority key.

methods.name: getBackendIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the highest priority backend in the set.
